Question 14
?

A particle P is moving along the curve y=2x2−3ex such that the x-coordinate of P is changing at the rate of 2cm/s. Find the rate of change of the y-coordinate when x=2cm.

a
−2(2+e2)cm/s
b
2(8−3e2)cm/s
c
2(2−8e2)cm/s
d
8−e2cm/s
e
(8+2e2)cm/s
Submit
